hints.tr: `push_str` bir `&str` ister; `&String` kendiliğinden ona dönüşür. `target.push_str(a)` yeterli.
hints.en: `push_str` wants a `&str`; a `&String` turns into one by itself. `target.push_str(a)` is enough.

tests.code: let (mut t, a, b) = (String::new(), String::from("ab"), String::from("abc")); append_longer(&mut t, &a, &b); assert_eq!(t, "abc");
let (mut t, a, b) = (String::new(), String::from("abc"), String::from("ab")); append_longer(&mut t, &a, &b); assert_eq!(t, "abc");
let (mut t, a, b) = (String::from("x"), String::from("aa"), String::from("bb")); append_longer(&mut t, &a, &b); assert_eq!(t, "xaa");
